paragraphs: Mar Zutra son of Rav Huna (who was the son of Rav Pappi), told Ravina: “We teach this statement of Rav Nechemyah son of Rav Yosef with reference to Rava’s ruling ….” Rav Ashi objects: Chullin 48a.
